LYNNONG I. Ka Jingkhaia V Jieu Khrist. Malh. 1 : 18-26 ; Louk. Hangno la kha ia U Jisu Khrist ? Ha Bethlehem Judia, ka shnong u Dabid. Ka Bethlehem ka don haei f Kumba hynriew mail shaphang shathie na Jerusalem. Kaei ka kmie jong U ? Ka Mari, ka theisotti.

Uei v tnga jong ka t U Joseph, u Misteri. Hangno ki ahong f Ha Nasaret, ka Bhnong ha Galilaia. Balei ki leit sha Bethlehem f Ban kheifi ia ki kat kum “ka hukum kaba la mih noh na u Kaisar Agustos, ban kheifi ia kiba shong ha ka pyrthei barob.” 2 7. Balei ki dei ban leit sha Bethlehem ban khein ia ki ? Namar ba “baroh ki leit ban kheifi ia ki uwei uwei baroh sha la ka jong ka jong ka shnong.” 8. Te ka Bethlehem ka la dei ka shnong ka Mari bad u Joseph ? Hooid, namar ki la long na ka ling bad ka jait a Dabid. IJ ana ba la iathuhlypa ban kha ia U Jisu ? Ha ka Mari ka kmie jong U, bad ha u Joseph. Dei ba la iathuhlypa ia kata ha ka Mari ? U angel U Trai uba la ong ha ka, “Hakhmih, phan kha ia U Khan, bad phan khot ia ka kyrteng jong U, U Jisu. Une Un long U Bakhraw bad U Khun U Bahakhlieh tam,” yn khot ia U. Balei ba la pynkyrteng Jisu ia U ? “Naba Un pynim ia la ki briew na ka pop jong ki.” 12.

Iathuh ia kiwei pat ki kyrteng U Jisu f U Khrist ; U Balasleh ; U Immanuel, kaba long haba la batai, U Blei lem bad ngi ; U Khun U Blei bad U Khun U Briew. La ong kumno shaphang kajakaha kaba la kha ia U ha Bethlehem ? “Te ka la kha ia U Khun ba nyngkong jong ka, bad ka la pynthiah ia U ha ka shyngoid.” 14. Math. 2 : 1-12 ; Louk. flano la pyntip nyngkong ba la kha ia U Jisu f Ha "ki nongaplangbrot kiba sha lum, bad kiba ia-ap miet ia ki kynhun langbrot jong ki. Kita ki nongaplangbrot ki la iohi iano ha Bethlehem 9 “Ki la shem ia ka Mari bad ia u Joseph, bad ia Uta U Khunlung, U da thiah ha kata ka shyngoid.” 6. Kumno ba la pyntip ia ki, ia ka jingkha jong U 9 Da u khlur uba ki la iohi na ka ri Mihngi. Ki la leit wad ia U shano 9 Sha Jerusalem, ka nongbah ka ri Kanaan. Uei uba laphah ia ki sha Bethlehem ? U Herod Syiem, haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh ki la hikai ia u. Kita ki riewstad ki la shem ia U Jisu hangno ? Ha ka ling, ha Bethlehem Judia, lem bad ka Mari ka kmie jong U. Kumno ki la shem ia kata ka ting 9 Uta u khlur, “u la leit sha shuwa jong ki, bad u la neh haneng kata ka jaka.” 12. Haba ki la iohi ia U ki la leh kumno 9 “Ki la iadem ki la iamane ruh ia u, bad haba ki la ialaw ia ka jingsong jong ki, ki la iatyrwa ai ia ki jingai ha U, ia ka ksiar, ia ka jingiwbih bad ia ka mirr de.” 13. Uei uba la ong ia kita ki riewstad ba kin wan iathuh pat ha u, ynda ki la shem ia U Jisu 9 U Herod Syiem. U Herod u mut aiu haba u ong kumta 9 Ha kaba paw, u la ong ban mane ia U : hynrei hapoh, u thew khnang ban pyniap ia U. Hato ki la leit pat sha u Herod 9 Em, naba U Blei U la maham ia ki ba kin ym leit, “Ki la ialeit noh sha la ka ri na kawei pat ka lynti.” 16. Haba kumta u Herod u la sngew kumno 9 U la bitar eh lep. Ka kam runar aiu u Herod m la leh, haba la shukor ia u 9 U la phah pyniap ia ki khunlung baroh kiba 5 ha Bethlehem, bad ki phang jong ka baroh, naduh kiba aranem bad kiba kham poh. Hynrei ka la jia kumno ia V Jisu f U Joseph, haba u angel U Trai u la maham ia u ha ka jingphohsniew, “u la shim noh ia Uta U Khunlung, bad ia ka kmie jong U mynmiet, bad u la leit noh sha ka ri Ijipt.” LTNNONG III.
